name: A group of at least three live silverfish spawned naturally inside an unchanged generated mineshaft
The natural pack remains above ground for over ten seconds with mob griefing enabled
Both graphical clients track the same live pack without recorded rendering errors
The fixture establishes silverfish already pursuing a nearby survival player
Naturally spawned silverfish switch from the player to acquire, chase and damage a zombie without forced targets
Only the actual final hitter earns credit and burrows; surviving pack members keep roaming
Both clients receive the killer's hidden inert state
Six-second effects and their particles expire while hidden without extending the burrow deadline
The hidden killer despawns after thirty seconds on server and both clients while the rest keep roaming
